Class XSecondaryMacroBlock

java.lang.Object
solvers.linearSystem.btf.ComponentBlock
solvers.linearSystem.btf.macroBlocks.SecondaryMacroBlock
solvers.linearSystem.btf.macroBlocks.XSecondaryMacroBlock
public class XSecondaryMacroBlock extends SecondaryMacroBlock
This class extends SecondaryMacroBlock to specify behavior specific to the Secondary Macro Blocks of the X Block. This includes inserting the correct coefficients for given equations and computing its size and position.
Author:
Jack Bradshaw
